'''J'Lan''' was a city on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. [[100 BBY/Legends|100 years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], J'Lan was hit by a massive [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]].
